messages:
emma: FYI reproducible dup-create with async client retries dropping Idempotency-Key when body is streamed. Minimal repro below.

emma: Code: ```py
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.post('/v1/resources', json={'name':'x'}, headers={'Idempotency-Key':'k1'}, retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=2))
```

sahil: Is the transport turning the body into a non-rewindable payload? That would explain missing header on replay.

luis: Correct. Transport bug: header snapshot not copied to retry envelope + aiohttp payload consumed. Plan: snapshot headers at send, buffer small bodies (<=1MB) for replay, mark large streams non-retriable unless Idempotency-Key present.

dana: Also a typing DX issue: BackoffStrategy and RetryPolicy aren't re-exported from package root, breaks strict mypy. Add top-level exports.

emma: I'll add a pytest-asyncio integration test and a tiny repro in examples/ for support. Pseudo: ```py
await server.delay(11); await client.post(..., headers={'Idempotency-Key':'abc'})
assert server.count_header('Idempotency-Key') == 2
```

ci-bot: CI build started for pr/transport/retry-fix (luis).

replay-bot: 2 customer incidents linked to duplicate-create; will attach PR when ready.

luis: Opening WIP PR with header-snapshot + buffer then will export types and update docs.

emma: Verified locally on branch	6 idempotency preserved across retries and duplicates gone. Will monitor CI. :thumbsup:
